project: AHRAS: An Auditable Uncertainty-Aware Adaptive Risk Controller for Closed-Loop Intrusion Detection and Response
canonical_runtime_path: Detection Evidence (Signature, ML Anomaly Ensemble, Welford Statistical Drift)
OOD / Zero-Day Detector (Mahalanobis Distance in Latent Representation Space)
Current Risk Formulation (Dynamic Threat Surface Calculation)
Future Risk Trajectory (Holt Causal Momentum Forecaster)
Split Conformal Selective Gate (Calibrated 7-Action Autonomy Decision)
Causal & Counterfactual XAI (Deterministic Graph Replay & Sensitivity)
Multi-Bank Continual Learning (5-Compartment Experience Replay Buffer)
Personalized Federated Learning (FedProx, FedKD & Byzantine Defense)

modules.name: detection/signature_engine
modules.research_role: Deterministic IOC matching, CVE signatures, and MITRE ATT&CK technique mapping.

modules.name: detection/anomaly_engine
modules.research_role: Behavioral point anomaly detection using tri-model ensemble (Isolation Forest, Autoencoder, One-Class SVM).

modules.name: detection/statistical_engine
modules.research_role: Non-stationary metric baseline tracking with Welford online variance and EWMA deviation.

modules.name: detection/multimodal_encoder
modules.research_role: Cross-modal and temporal multi-head attention over Network, Process, Identity, and Graph channels.
modules.outputs: ModalityVectors (z_net, z_proc, z_id, z_graph, z_fused, temporal_alphas)

modules.name: detection/feature_selector
modules.research_role: Context-conditioned dynamic feature selection for dimensionality reduction and noise suppression.
modules.inputs: Feature vector x, Context vector z
modules.outputs: Continuous feature mask m_t in [0, 1]^D, Masked features x_masked

modules.name: detection/gnn_engine
modules.research_role: Temporal heterogeneous graph neural network for multi-hop lateral movement and entity correlation.
modules.inputs: Entity graph adjacency matrix, Node feature embeddings
modules.outputs: GNN Node Suspiciousness score in [0, 1], Graph embeddings H

modules.name: detection/attack_path
modules.research_role: Probabilistic Noisy-OR attack episode aggregation and coordinated campaign tracking.
modules.inputs: Multi-hop graph paths, Episode entity embeddings

modules.name: adaptive_learning/weight_learner
modules.research_role: Context-gated adaptive fusion, evidence quality scoring, covariance de-correlation, and 5-bank continual learning.
modules.inputs: Evidence scores, observation age, covariance matrix, analyst feedback
modules.outputs: Dynamic weights w_i', EvidenceQuality Q_i, Balanced replay batches

modules.name: detection/selective_gate
modules.research_role: Split conformal selective autonomy controller enforcing statistical error bounds across 7 actions.
modules.inputs: Risk score R_t, Uncertainty U_t, OOD score, Calibrated quantile tau*

modules.name: forecast/predictor
modules.research_role: Holt causal double-exponential smoothing for early warning momentum and horizon risk projection.
modules.outputs: ForecastResult (P_fore, h1/h3/h5 predictions, threshold crossing probability)

modules.name: xai/causal_explainer
modules.research_role: Deterministic causal decision DAG generation, sensitivity gradients, and counterfactual minimality calculation.
modules.inputs: DecisionTrace inputs and intermediate risk terms
modules.outputs: CausalDecisionGraph DAG, Counterfactual minimal changes, Delta R values

modules.name: xai/llm_narrator
modules.research_role: Guardrailed evidence-grounded incident summarization and executive report generation.
modules.inputs: Verified DecisionTrace, CTI feeds, Untrusted analyst prompt strings
modules.outputs: Sanitized incident summary narrative, Executive remediation playbook

modules.name: adaptive_learning/active_learner
modules.research_role: Information-theoretic acquisition scoring combining epistemic uncertainty, OOD novelty, and conformal abstention.
modules.inputs: Uncertainty U_t, OOD score, Abstention flag
modules.outputs: Acquisition score, Ground-truth analyst feedback injection

modules.name: federated/fed_learning
modules.research_role: Personalized FedProx, Federated Knowledge Distillation, temporal client reputation tracking, and Byzantine coordinate median defense.
modules.inputs: Local client model updates, Gradient norms, Historical client honesty
modules.outputs: Reputation-weighted global model weights, Distilled consensus logits

modules.name: response/orchestrator
modules.research_role: RASE safety-constrained response execution with blast radius limits, reversible actions, and honeypot deception.
modules.inputs: Risk score R_t, Selected action, Asset criticality
modules.outputs: Executed containment plan, Deception redirection, Operational audit
